title: pongelion malabaricum
intro: Pongelion malabaricum, commonly known as Indian spikenard, is a perennial plant species native to the Western Ghats of India. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of anxiety, insomnia, and various skin conditions, such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Pongelion malabaricum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting cells from oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include compounds like sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
